text:
ravi: Quick flag from research: folks are tripping over compact scorecard hotkeys. They expect Enter to open a diff, not trigger approve. Recording: https://recordings.redwood.ai/compactsession.mp4

ada: yeah i've noticed that too in usability testing. Current mapping (Enter=approve, Space=select) is surprising.

noah: what if we standardize: Enter=open, Space=toggle select, Shift+Enter=approve? On mac add Cmd+Enter alias.

mika: agree. also visual hint needed when row is focused. a tiny keyboard chip with icons would help discoverability.

ravi: accessibility note: chips and tooltips are invisible to screen readers unless we provide aria-describedby hooks. let's add an sr-only description element per row and point aria-describedby at it.

ada: also the approve action must be labelled as "Approve test run" not just an icon. screen-reader users missed the meaning during testing.

noah: snackbar behavior: show "Approved 2 tests — Undo" and include aria-live=assertive text so assistive tech hears it. don't move focus to snackbar.

mika: small design trade: the chip might be too wide in compact rows. render it only on focus and hover. use truncated symbols: "Enter ▶ Space ␣ Shift+Enter ✔"

ravi: implementation detail: debounce aria-live updates (250ms) and only update when panel opens or an action completes, not on simple focus changes. prevents spamming screen readers.

ada: tests: add an axe smoke test checking the presence of aria-describedby on focused rows and a unit test asserting the live region message contains the prompt set name on open.

noah: also update keyboard help in the top-right help menu so power users can see all shortcuts in one place.

mika: action items: ravi -> write a11y spec with live region copy and debounce; ada -> update copy tokens for approve/snackbar; noah -> prototype shortcut aliases and top-right help; mika -> add compact hint chip mock in Figma.

ux-bot: created task PROD-3412 "Compact scorecard: hotkey alignments + a11y fixes" (https://tasks.redwood.ai/3412) assigned to ravi and mika

ravi: thanks team. i'll ping when PR for aria-describedby/live-region is ready.
